usage: Save as csv_records.py. After operator review, run: python3 csv_records.py < input.json. Supply one JSON object containing text and delimiter (comma, semicolon, or tab). Alternatively, import convert_csv and pass that object directly. Output is {"records":[...]} or {"error":"invalid_input"}. Values remain strings, preserving Unicode, empty fields, whitespace, and quoted embedded newlines. Headers must be unique and every data row must match the header width; malformed quoting rejects the entire input. Empty input is invalid; a header-only CSV returns an empty records array. Uses Python 3 standard library only. Source has not been executed.
